programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Life on the Bay
programme.desc: Caravan park manager Steven has volunteered at the nearby RNLI station since he was 17, and today he is on call. Meanwhile, one resident goes for a dip with the bay's wild swimmers, head chef James welcomes a new recruit to the kitchen and the sun shines on a fund-raising fete

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Summer arrives and Robert's cattle get their first taste of freedom and fresh grass in the Cairngorms, while Jenni's alpacas need a short back and sides from a specialist shearer. In North Uist, a herd is being prepared for an epic journey across a tidal sandbar linking the island of Vallay to the mainland and the croft's bulls. In Moray, Nikki and Ollie are at last about to complete one of their holiday pods

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: A crew from the special operations team attends a two-car crash in East Ayrshire, treating a patient and reassuring her startled and worried husband and son. In Buckie, two local paramedics attend to a variety of duties from an elderly man with breathing difficulties to someone who has fallen at home while crafting handmade fishing nets. They also head to a police custody suite, where a man is refusing medical treatment for a nasty self-inflicted wound to the neck. Narrated by John Michie

programme.title: Back from the Brink
programme.desc: Wildlife film-maker Libby Penman presents mores success stories from across Europe that showcase the work of conservationists fighting to save animals and plants. There are reports on bottlenose dolphins thriving in Aberdeen harbour, pioneering designers in Munich who are reimagining urban construction with wildlife at its heart, and a scientific community on Ibiza rallying towns together to save a lizard species

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Discussion on Scotland's biggest news stories, with analysis from journalists, commentators and guests. Hosted by Martin Geissler

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: Grado and Judith Ralston hit the road for an action-packed adventure in Perth & Kinross.. As well as spending the night in their very own houseboats on Loch Tay, a beautifully converted former manse near Blair Athol and some bespoke fairy-tale hideaways close to Dunblane, they experience Perthshire's wild side - with some tubing and a bungee jump

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: A fictionalised version of pop star Charli XCX navigates the complexities of fame and industry pressure while preparing for her arena tour debut. Mockumentary, starring Charli XCX, Rosanna Arquette and Kate Berlant

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: Political prisoner Valentín shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency, where an unlikely bond forms between the pair as the latter recounts a glamorous Hollywood movie. Adaptation of the stage musical, based on the novel by Manuel Puig, starring Diego Luna, Jennifer Lopez and Tonatiuh

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: One Last Shot
programme.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network. Director James Nunn's thriller, starring Scott Adkins, Steven Cree and Hannah Ware

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: Open Season 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel. Elliott the deer puts his marriage plans on hold to help organise the rescue of Mr Weenie the dachshund, who has been dognapped.

programme.title: Open Season 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure in which Boog the grizzly bear joins a travelling circus, forcing his friends to organise his escape once they realise he's going to be shipped overseas.

programme.title: Open Season: Scared Silly
programme.desc: Boog, Elliot and their pals team up to track down an elusive werewolf and prevent their forest from being intruded upon by hunter Shaw. Animation, with the voice of Will Townsend and Donny Lucas

programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
programme.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life in this edition. From Sing to The Bad Guys 2, enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob journeys to the ocean's depths to face the Flying Dutchman's ghost, encountering challenges and uncovering marine mysteries. Animation, with the voices of Tom Kenny, Bill Fagerbakke and Mark Hamill

programme.title: The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scientists!
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman Animations, featuring the voices of Hugh Grant, David Tennant and Martin Freeman. Pirate Captain may be the leader of a shambolic crew of buccaneers but he's still determined to win the coveted Pirate of the Year competition, even if it means fighting off fearsome rivals Black Bellamy, Peg-Leg Hastings and Cutlass Liz to see who can amass the most booty.

programme.title: Mr Peabody and Sherman
programme.desc: Animated sci-fi adventure, featuring the voices of Ty Burrell and Max Charles. Super-intelligent dog Mr Peabody and his adopted boy Sherman use their time machine to experience great moments in history. However, when the boy takes fellow student Penny back in time and causes a rift, it's up to his canine mentor to rescue them both before her parents realise she's missing.

programme.title: Goat
programme.desc: A goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity sport dominated by the fiercest animals. Animated adventure, with the voices of Caleb McLaughlin and Gabrielle Union

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jackie Chan, Dave Franco and Justin Theroux as the Lego figures. Teenager Lloyd is secretly part of a team of heroes who protect their city from the evil Lord Garmadon - who happens to be Lloyd's father.

programme.title: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part
programme.desc: Five years after events of the first film, teenager Finn has rebuilt Bricksburg into a post-apocalyptic wasteland. When Emmet is plagued by a vision of an impending cataclysm, he and Lucy fight to protect their beloved city from invaders. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Elizabeth Banks and Will Arnett

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Louis CK, Eric Stonestreet and Kevin Hart. Pampered pooch Max is forced into drastic action when his owner brings home a rescue mongrel to share their Manhattan apartment.

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Patton Oswalt, Kevin Hart and Harrison Ford. Life changes for Max the dog when his owner has a child, turning Max into something of an overprotective worrier. However, a family trip introduces him to grizzled farm dog Rooster, who helps him overcome his fears. Meanwhile, Max's rabbit pal Snowball angers a tyrannical circus owner, plunging the pet gang into imminent danger.

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: Worthy feature-length adaptation of the animated TV series, featuring the voices of Tim Curry, Brenda Blethyn, Marisa Tomei and Rupert Everett. Young Eliza Thornberry has a very special gift - she can converse with animals. But when a trip with her nature documentary-making family to Africa brings her into contact with evil poachers, the youngster has to decide whether she is prepared to give up this wonderful power to save the country's endangered wildlife.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure featuring the voices of Nicole Kidman, Elijah Wood and Robin Williams. In the freezing Antarctic, Emperor penguins find their soul mate through their own unique "heart song". Unfortunately for young bird Mumble, he can't sing a note, but he can tap dance brilliantly. Social rejection soon follows, leading his "happy feet" to be blamed for a colony-threatening fish famine. Determined to prove his worth, Mumble heads off on a perilous journey to discover the truth about what has happened to the fish stocks.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.title: Corpse Bride
programme.desc: Animated fantasy directed by Tim Burton and featuring the voices of Helena Bonham Carter, Johnny Depp and Albert Finney. As he prepares for his arranged marriage to Victoria Everglot, Victor Van Dort goes into the woods to practise his vows and unwittingly slips the ring onto the finger of a corpse. How will he explain to his fiancée that he has married another - and that she happens to be dead?

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: Black comedy action horror starring Harvey Keitel, George Clooney, Quentin Tarantino and Juliette Lewis. Fleeing the law, two murderous brothers kidnap a priest and his family, driving the priest's Winnebago south for a rendezvous at a lowlife bar in Mexico. Little do they know that the bar's staff and regulars hide a blood-drenched secret.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Beast of War
programme.desc: A group of soldiers get stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean after their ship is sunk, and must battle a great white shark. Writer/director Kiah Roache-Turner's horror thriller, starring Mark Coles Smith and Joel Nankervis

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby

programme.title: 47 Metres Down
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Mandy Moore and Claire Holt. Two thrill-seeking sisters go on a shark-watching trip, but their adventure turns into a nightmare when their shark-proof cage becomes detached from the boat and plummets to the ocean floor. With their air running out and great whites circling, the women realise they are in big trouble.

programme.title: Die Alone
programme.desc: A young couple flee the city during a zombie outbreak, only to be involved in a car crash. When the man awakes, his girlfriend is missing, so he bands together with a rugged survivalist to find his partner - but he only has selected memories of what he has been through. Apocalypse drama, starring Carrie-Anne Moss, Douglas Smith, Frank Grillo and Kimberley-Sue Murray

programme.title: Presence
programme.desc: Supernatural drama starring Lucy Liu, Callina Liang and Chris Sullivan. A mute ghost watches on as a family moves into a spacious suburban home and hidden tensions rise to the surface. Mother Rebekah seems to be involved in a crime, while teenage daughter Chloe, who is grieving after a friend's fatal overdose, begins to sense the unseen presence when it intervenes in the family's life.

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Supernatural horror starring Lin Shaye. Psychic Elise Rainier returns to her childhood home, where she must confront her own past traumas in order to exorcise the property.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: Comedy starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. With the children now able to walk and talk, the Ubriacco family acquire a mongrel puppy, Rocks. As the Christmas season approaches the family's usual struggles are complicated by the unexpected gift of Daphne, a pampered poodle.

programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy adventure based on the first three titles in the bestselling children's book series, starring Jim Carrey and Meryl Streep. After their parents die in a mysterious fire, three young siblings are entrusted to the care of their distant relative, the evil Count Olaf. An actor and master of disguise, he's prepared to go to any length to swindle them out of their family fortune.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Michael Caine and Josh Hutcherson. A teenage adventurer locates an island inhabited by monster lizards, giant bees and a gold volcano.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: Horror comedy based on the popular books by R L Stine, starring Jack Black. When 15-year-old Zach breaks into his neighbour's house to investigate strange noises, he discovers that he lives next door to the author of the Goosebumps series, whose monstrous creations have to be kept in locked manuscripts. But when the monsters get loose, it's up to Zach to help imprison them again.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: Two youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from a locked manuscript they find in an abandoned house. Comedy sequel, starring Madison Iseman, Jeremy Ray Taylor and Wendy McLendon-Covey

programme.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spy comedy starring Rowan Atkinson. Bumbling MI7 agent Johnny English has found a new life as a geography teacher. But when a cyber attack exposes Britain's spooks, he is forced to come out of retirement, and enlists his former sidekick Jeremy to help him flush out the hacker responsible.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring James Cromwell. Babe, an orphaned pig, is raised on a farm by the sheepdog Fly. Although he is destined for the dinner table, Babe astonishes Farmer Hoggett and his fellow farmyard animals when he shows talent as a "sheep-pig".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The tiny blue forest-dwelling creatures flee from an evil wizard, only to end up magically transported to modern-day New York. They search for a way to get back to their own village while evading their enemy, who has followed them to the Big Apple. Fantasy comedy, with Neil Patrick Harris, Hank Azaria and Jayma Mays, plus voices of Jonathan Winters and Katy Perry

programme.title: The Smurfs 2
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy starring Neil Patrick Harris. After all her friends appear to have forgotten her birthday, Smurfette runs away from the village, only to be snatched through a portal to the real world, by the evil Gargamel. To get her back, the other Smurfs must travel to our world, reuniting with some old friends along the way, before she can give Gargamel the formula to make his own Smurfs. UNCHECKED

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Bruce Willis. The crack team of mercenaries take on what looks like the easy job of retrieving an item from a crashed plane in Albania. But when one of the group is murdered by an international arms dealer, it turns into a mission of revenge.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: Sequel to the 1989 action fantasy Batman, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer. The Caped Crusader returns to action when Gotham City is threatened by corrupt tycoon Max Shreck and the vengeful Penguin. As he battles the forces of crime, Batman discovers a deadly new foe in the shape of feline vigilante, Catwoman.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey, Nicole Kidman and Chris O'Donnell. Former district attorney Harvey Two-Face holds Batman responsible for the attack that left half of his face disfigured, while brilliant scientist Edward Nygma bears a grudge against Batman's alter ego, Bruce Wayne, for rejecting one of his experiments. The pair decide to combine forces to exact their revenge.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Jeff Goldblum and Julianne Moore. Past experience tells Dr Ian Malcolm not to get involved with businessman John Hammond's new scheme to build a dinosaur park. However, he reluctantly agrees when he realises that his girlfriend is already on site. On his arrival on the secluded island he soon finds that his fears were well founded.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring James Cromwell. Babe, an orphaned pig, is raised on a farm by the sheepdog Fly. Although he is destined for the dinner table, Babe astonishes Farmer Hoggett and his fellow farmyard animals when he shows talent as a "sheep-pig".

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy adventure based on EB White's children's story, starring Hugh Laurie and Geena Davis, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox. The Littles want to adopt a younger brother for their son, George. At the orphanage they are charmed by a young mouse called Stuart, and decide to take him home. While George is stunned by his new companion, the family cat, Snowbell, is delighted.

programme.title: The Wizard of Oz
programme.desc: Classic musical fantasy starring Judy Garland, Ray Bolger, Bert Lahr and Jack Haley. When a huge tornado hits Dorothy's home in Kansas, she is whisked off far away into a strange and dazzling world. There she must escape the clutches of the Wicked Witch of the West and find her way to the Emerald City.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Two lookalike youngsters trade places to help resolve each other's problems. Children's comedy, starring Kirstie Alley, Steve Guttenberg and Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen

programme.title: The Wiz
programme.desc: Musical based on The Wizard of Oz, featuring an all-black cast. Dorothy is suddenly whisked off to a magical land and makes some unusual friends as she tries to get back home, while avoiding the malevolent attentions of a wicked witch. Directed by Sidney Lumet, starring Diana Ross, Michael Jackson and Richard Pryor

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy starring Bill Murray, Sigourney Weaver and Dan Aykroyd. Three university professors researching parapsychology set up in business for themselves when their grant is withdrawn, and soon realise there's a burgeoning market for "ghost busters" in New York City.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy sequel starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver and Harold Ramis. The Ghostbusters are reunited when their old client Dana Barrett calls for help. Now a single parent with an eight-month-old baby son, she is once again having problems with supernatural phenomena.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Comic fantasy based on the book by Roald Dahl, starring Mara Wilson and Danny DeVito. Matilda, the daughter of Harry and Zinnia Wormwood, has adored reading from a precociously early age, but her parents refuse to let her go to school. Until, that is, her father sends her to the unforgiving Miss Trunchbull's Crunchem Hall, where she discovers that she has other more useful gifts.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Two lookalike youngsters trade places to help resolve each other's problems. Children's comedy, starring Kirstie Alley, Steve Guttenberg and Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: Comedy starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. With the children now able to walk and talk, the Ubriacco family acquire a mongrel puppy, Rocks. As the Christmas season approaches the family's usual struggles are complicated by the unexpected gift of Daphne, a pampered poodle.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy starring Bill Murray, Sigourney Weaver and Dan Aykroyd. Three university professors researching parapsychology set up in business for themselves when their grant is withdrawn, and soon realise there's a burgeoning market for "ghost busters" in New York City.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: Central Intelligence
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Dwayne Johnson and Kevin Hart. Life gets dangerous for bored accountant Calvin Joyner when he reconnects with a former school classmate who now works in international espionage.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: Mr Deeds
programme.desc: Remake of Frank Capra's comedy Mr Deeds Goes to Town, starring Adam Sandler and Winona Ryder. Longfellow Deeds lives an uncomplicated life as a pizza-shop owner and aspiring greetings-card writer in a tiny town. But his world is thrown into disarray when he inherits a fortune from an unknown uncle.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Canine comedy featuring the voice of Owen Wilson. When the family of irrepressible Great Dane Marmaduke moves to a new home in California, it all proves to be something of a culture shock for the hapless hound, who continues to wreak havoc wherever he goes.

programme.title: The Deb
programme.desc: A young farmer hopes a debutante ball will transform her life. Her city cousin arrives after being expelled from school and scoffs at the traditions. As they search for dates, the teenagers challenge each other's assumptions. Comedy musical, starring Natalie Abbott, Charlotte MacInnes, and Rebel Wilson, who also directed

programme.title: Central Intelligence
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Dwayne Johnson and Kevin Hart. Life gets dangerous for bored accountant Calvin Joyner when he reconnects with a former school classmate who now works in international espionage.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: Suspense thriller starring Morgan Freeman. Following the abduction of a senator's daughter, psychological profiler Alex Cross is forced to join the hunt when he's contacted by the kidnapper. Working closely with the agent responsible for security at the girl's school, Cross uncovers a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: While stuck at a rural Arizona rest stop, a salesman is thrust into a hostage situation by the arrival of two ruthless bank robbers. Writer/director Francis Galluppi's crime thriller, starring Jim Cummings, Faizon Love and Jocelin Donahue

programme.title: Lurker
programme.desc: A retail employee infiltrates the inner circle of an artist on the verge of stardom. As he gets closer to the budding music star, access and proximity become a matter of life and death. Writer/director Alex Russell's crime drama, starring Théodore Pellerin, Archie Madekwe and Sunny Suljic

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Clint Eastwood. San Francisco cop "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned the case of a sniper who has murdered a young girl and threatened further killings if his ransom demand is not met. Dismayed to find himself partnered with a raw recruit, Callahan is soon at odds with his bosses over whether to pay off the killer.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: Suspense thriller starring Morgan Freeman. Following the abduction of a senator's daughter, psychological profiler Alex Cross is forced to join the hunt when he's contacted by the kidnapper. Working closely with the agent responsible for security at the girl's school, Cross uncovers a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Moneyball
programme.desc: The manager of a struggling baseball team faces disaster, as his star players are bought out by richer clubs and he is unable to afford to replace them. An economics student offers him a solution to his problems, finding a ground-breaking way to analyse the performance of cheaper players and combining their abilities to form a winning side. Fact-based drama, starring Brad Pitt, Jonah Hill and Philip Seymour Hoffman

programme.title: Cookster: The Darkest Days
programme.desc: Misunderstood by his family, a dyslexic teen becomes a drug dealer, descending into addiction and debt while a dangerous rival threatens his world and his relationship. Drama, starring Craige Middleburg and Nick Moran

programme.title: The Breakfast Club
programme.desc: Teenage drama starring Emilio Estevez and Molly Ringwald. A group of five strangers are thrown together one Saturday in high-school detention. Before the day is over, they will break all the rules, bare their souls and find true friendship in the unlikeliest of places.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: A grieving son returns to England to mourn his father, the CEO of Elsinore Property. The shell-shocked Hamlet learns plans are already afoot for his uncle Claudius to marry his mother Gertrude just days after losing her husband. Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story starring Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba and Kevin Costner. Following a career-ending injury, skier Molly Bloom makes ends meet as a waitress. However, after discovering the world of high-stakes poker, she builds her own gambling empire, which makes her rich - and attracts a major federal investigation.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Second World War drama based on the novel by JG Ballard, starring Christian Bale and John Malkovich. When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: Comedy drama, based on the true story of conman Frank Abagnale Jr, starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks. Shattered by the news that his parents are divorcing, 16-year-old Frank runs away to New York. For six years he lives a life of fraud, cashing over $2 million in bad cheques while impersonating an airline pilot, a paediatrician and a lawyer, and always staying one step ahead of tenacious FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short and Meg Ryan. In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Men In Black Films
programme.desc: A look at the blockbusting fantasy comedies, starring Will Smith, Tommy Lee Jones and more

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring Harrison Ford and Ryan Gosling. Los Angeles blade runner Officer K uncovers a shocking secret that puts him on the trail of Rick Deckard, who has been missing for 30 years. Meanwhile, corporate magnate Niander Wallace seeks the truth about so-called replicant reproduction in order to further his plans for interstellar colonisation.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller starring Jennifer Lawrence. In annual retribution for a failed uprising in the totalitarian state of Panem, each of 12 districts is forced to select a young boy and girl to take part in a televised fight to the death. When her younger sister is chosen, the resourceful Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her place.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Science-fiction comedy starring Will Smith and Josh Brolin. The fight against aliens is taken to a new dimension when Agent J is forced to travel back to 1969 in an effort to prevent his partner's murder by ruthless fugitive Boris the Animal.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Tessa Thompson and Chris Hemsworth. Agent M, an eager rookie in the secret MIB organiation, is sent to the London office where she's partnered with laid-back Agent H. When their first assignment together ends in disaster, M begins to suspect a mole must have infiltrated the agency. But who could it be - and is her partner to be trusted?

programme.title: Titane
programme.desc: Psychological horror drama starring Agathe Rousselle and Vincent Lindon. After committing a string of brutal murders, car showroom dancer Alexia goes on the run. Shaving her head and breaking her nose to hide her identity, she poses as the long-absent son of kindly firefighter Vincent. But with a miraculous pregnancy beginning to show, Alexia can only keep up her ruse for so long.

programme.title: Gunman's Walk
programme.desc: Western starring Van Heflin and Tab Hunter. Growing up in the shadow of former gunslinger Lee Hackett is a tough proposition for his sons Ed and Davy. While Davy looks for love, Ed's explosive temperament threatens to destroy everything his father has built.

programme.title: Living Interview Special
programme.desc: Bill Nighy, writer Kazuo Ishiguro and director Oliver Hermanus talk about making their beautiful and melancholy new drama

programme.title: Written on the Wind
programme.desc: Melodrama starring Rock Hudson, Lauren Bacall and Robert Stack. When Lucy Moore falls in love with the handsome son of a Texas millionaire, her life is transformed. But Kyle Hadley is a tormented man with a secret that not even Moore can discover until it's too late.

programme.title: Man in the Saddle
programme.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott and Joan Leslie. Wealthy Will Isham is determined to destroy rancher Owen Merritt, worried that he may make off with his wife, Leslie, who is obviously smitten by him.

programme.title: The War Wagon
programme.desc: Western starring John Wayne and Kirk Douglas. Taw Jackson and Lomax are two rivals who decide to bury the hatchet when Jackson is released from jail on parole. They plan to rob the greedy mine owner who put Jackson behind bars but they have to contend with the "war wagon", the mine owner's ingenious way of protecting his gold.

programme.title: My Stepmother Is an Alien
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dan Aykroyd and Kim Basinger. When widowed scientist Steven Mills inadvertently makes contact with a far-off planet, the beautiful Celeste is sent to Earth to locate the man who could be the key to saving her alien civilisation.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: Midnight Run
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Robert De Niro and Charles Grodin. Bounty hunter Jack Walsh is just the man to bring embezzler Jonathan "The Duke" Mardukas to justice. Down on his luck, the $100,000 fee is just what Jack needs right now. The only problem is that Mardukas cheated the Mafia out of a cool $15 million, and they want their money back. Can Jack beat the FBI and an unscrupulous rival to his quarry?

programme.title: Beyond Suspicion
programme.desc: On his release from a prison sentence for crimes of which he was innocent, a shamed former cop connects a murder case to a government conspiracy involving rogue agents from a top spy agency. Crime thriller, starring Karl Urban, Sofia Vergara and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: Standoff
programme.desc: A troubled former soldier who is haunted by his past actions comes to the aid of a 12-year-old girl who has witnessed a murder. He vows to protect her from the assassin pursuing her, but is forced to use unconventional methods to keep the killer at bay when he realises his gun only has one bullet. Thriller, starring Thomas Jane and Laurence Fishburne

programme.title: 7 Guardians of the Tomb
programme.desc: A team of scientists lose a colleague in an ancient labyrinth, and must battle their way through a swarm of man-eating spiders to discover the secret behind the arachnids' power. Sci-fi adventure, starring Li Bingbing, Kellan Lutz and Kelsey Grammer

programme.desc: The explorer's last hope of leaving the plateau is destroyed when Drakul and his men come after them and their hot air balloon. A war breaks out between Drakul and Tribune, who is now armed with gunpowder.

programme.title: Aberfan: The Village That Fought Back
programme.desc: The catastrophic collapse in 1966 of a coal-waste tip above the south Wales village of Aberfan remains one of the most devastating tragedies in modern British history. The slide engulfed a school and neighbouring homes, claiming the lives of 116 children and 28 adults in a disaster that shocked the world, but the story of what followed has been largely forgotten. Marking the 60th anniversary, this documentary uncovers the little-told story of the extraordinary campaign that emerged in the disaster's aftermath, revealing how a shattered village rose from unimaginable grief to demand justice, challenged the most powerful institutions in Britain, and forced the removal of the coal tips that still loomed above their homes

Stacey conducts a test to find out if it might work, and shocks the doctors in the lab with online deepfakes created to get them to promote new trends

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring David Oyelowo and Tom Wilkinson. Alabama, 1965: although segregation in the United States is supposed to have ended, equal votes for black people in the Deep South is still not a reality. Nobel prize-winning civil rights leader Dr Martin Luther King meets with President Lyndon B Johnson and asks him to act, but when Johnson stalls, Dr King goes to Selma, Alabama, and initiates a series of demonstrations and marches that will change the face of America.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Anita Rani and Sean Fletcher head to the South Pennines to join archaeologists and conservationists uncovering the remarkable ways peat is preserving the past while helping to protect the future. Meanwhile, John Craven reveals the winner of this year's Countryfile Photography Competition, for Children in Need

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors
programme.desc: As suspense fills the air, the burning question on the players minds is, who has been murdered, and will the answer help to reveal a traitor? In the mission, the celebrity players come face to face with death, and as evening descends, the round table brings a fractious atmosphere, but will it conclude with a traitor being unveiled or the loss of another innocent faithful?

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
programme.desc: Ed Gamble and guests hear from the players banished and murdered in episode five, who find out who the Traitors really are

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Christina Trevanion presents from Shepton Mallet, Somerset, and puzzles passers-by with a geometric mystery object. Ben Cooper and Danny Sebastian aid two teams of college friends

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie Dimmock and Florence Headlam travel to Stourbridge to help Vicki and Mark transform their barren garden into a stunning bumblebee haven. With only a towering copper beech tree to work around, the couple dream of creating a stylish yet welcoming outdoor retreat for dining, entertaining and relaxation

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: The newsreader goes on a trip to reconnect with family, explore his heritage and experience the rich mix of cultures that makes island life so special. Clive begins by meeting up with his sister and exploring the wild beauty of eastern Jamaica, encountering descendants of rebel mountain communities, visiting a high-altitude coffee farm, learning the secrets of jerk pork and bedding down 100ft above the Caribbean Sea

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell returns with the quiz based on patience and lateral thinking, with microbiologists the Culture Club taking on rowers the Makeweights in the opening heat. The teams try to draw together the connections between things that at first glance seem utterly random, with one set of clues asking what links Germany, HM Treasury, the Galactic Republic, and the Duchy of Lancaster

programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.desc: The First Minister answers questions from MSs from the Senedd in Cardiff Bay

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: In Ironbridge Gorge on the River Severn, Michael Portillo explores this hotbed of industrial innovation and takes a ride on a replica of the world's first steam locomotive. He also investigates the rich heritage of the Black Country in Wolverhampton with a lesson in 'yam yam'. In Coseley, Michael discovers that one of the area's most successful industries, brickmaking, continues at Ketley Brick

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Sarah Moore heads to at Woking Recycling Centre on a mission to stop quality discards from hitting the skips. She intercepts a retro swivel chair and a once-cherished sideboard. With the help of upholsterer Simion Hawtin-Smith and print artist Zoe Murphy, the items are soon revitalised

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Mark Stacey and Michael Baggott assess items brought into Newby Hall in North Yorkshire. Mark comes across an interesting Clarice Cliff cake plate and Michael enjoys an ancient Chinese urn. Presenter Paul Martin takes in the splendours of the country house's Adams interiors

programme.title: House of Games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two

programme.title: Gymnastics: World Championships 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the men's team final, held this year at Rotterdam Ahoy, the Netherlands. Last year's championships did not feature team competitions, as is the norm the year after an Olympic Games, so this event last featured three years ago in Antwerp. A Japan team spearheaded by Daiki Hashimoto, who won two more golds, were victorious on that occasion, with China finishing second and USA claiming bronze

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: When a surfer is left paralysed by a wave, the Appledore crew are tasked with an immediate launch. It soon becomes clear that the casualty has been saved from drowning by a teenage boy. In Little and Broad Haven, south Wales, there's a frantic search for two paddleboarders swept over a mile out to sea. Also, the Hayling Island crew race against time to rescue a fisherman trapped in mud

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Paddy O'Connell

programme.title: Aberfan: The Village That Fought Back
programme.desc: The catastrophic collapse in 1966 of a coal-waste tip above the south Wales village of Aberfan remains one of the most devastating tragedies in modern British history. The slide engulfed a school and neighbouring homes, claiming the lives of 116 children and 28 adults in a disaster that shocked the world, but the story of what followed has been largely forgotten. Marking the 60th anniversary, this documentary uncovers the little-told story of the extraordinary campaign that emerged in the disaster's aftermath, revealing how a shattered village rose from unimaginable grief to demand justice, challenged the most powerful institutions in Britain, and forced the removal of the coal tips that still loomed above their homes

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Recording artist Darius Rucker goes undercover to find America's next great musical act. Darius first gained fame as lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist of rock band Hootie & the Blowfish, selling over 16 million records and winning two Grammys. He then went on to have a successful solo career as a county music artist. Now Darius wants to find talented but undiscovered new music acts and help launch their careers, so dons a disguise to work at an open mic night, as a roadie and a busker in his efforts to locate fresh songwriting and performing talent

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Chef and restaurateur Marcus Samuelsson goes undercover to find and mentor America's next great chef. An Ethiopian refugee adopted by a Swedish family, Marcus developed a deep love for cooking at an early age and has since become a renowned force in international cuisine, with over 30 restaurants worldwide. Marcus disguises himself to work incognito in a teaching kitchen, a food truck business, a culinary institute and a soup kitchen, as he searches for undiscovered chefs to mentor

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Notting Hill, West London, Queen and Shawn kick off the culinary competition with a menu inspired by their Thai and West Indian heritage, but well-travelled foodies Suzy and Paul are unimpressed. When one of the hosts reveals a dislike of West Londoners, the guests are left stunned, while day two sees Suzy and Paul prepare a French feast, but Shawn sees the evening as pretentious. Finally, fun-loving couple Charlotte and Kevin put together a trendy Japanese menu, before the winners of the £1,000 prize money are revealed

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples from the south coast of England compete for the £1,000 cash prize, with partners Lauren and Claire kicking off proceedings and hoping to impress with a menu of experimental flavour combinations. Day two sees Cindy and Rod serve up a similar menu to the night before, before Marian and Stewart host the final evening, which involves wholesome classic food and bit of banjo

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Competitive adrenaline junkie Mark wants to fly high on his big day and has an adventurous plan to take his wedding to the sky. While Mark aims to go above and beyond to make his wedding First Class, no nonsense Lynsey just hopes he is thinking about her first and foremost

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride

They meet a kitchen porter, an assistant manager and a dock supervisor for their main shrimp supplier, in a bid to get to the heart of their business. In the end, Brandon and Drew reveal their true identities and help make their employees' dreams a reality.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA

programme.desc: A commuter turboprop slams into the side of a hill in New Zealand, and the search for answers inevitably leads to the cockpit

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: The causes and unforeseen outcomes of 10 collisions between trains, ships and aircraft

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Fuzz Townshend and Tim Shaw restore a Jaguar Mk2 that has been in its owner's family for 40 years, but which he has been unable to work on following an operation. Now, after sitting neglected in a garage for nearly two decades, the duo battle to start the Jag's engine and Tim has to get his hands dirty making parts

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Brace for disaster as highways fall, bridges collapse and buildings crumble in a global tour of shocking engineering failures

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The 1985 Manchester runway disaster, in which an aircraft's engine failed, causing the deaths of 55 people

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: After coming ashore with the French-Canadian Regiment de la Chaudiere on D-Day, a sniper loses the sight in one eye during the battle for Caen but refuses to be sent home and rejoins his regiment. In April 1944, as the Chaudieres Leo Major volunteers to try and make contact with the Dutch resistance in the city of Zwolle, and manages to liberate the city without the loss of civilian life.

programme.title: The City Under the Sea: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: In ancient times, the Mediterranean was home to some of the greatest civilizations the world has ever seen. Scientific data, combined with computer graphics, can drain the sea to unlock mysteries about the rise and fall of the Minoans, the Greeks, the Carthaginians and the mighty Romans, while unveiling the powerful natural forces at work in this unique region.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Archaeologists hunt for clues to explain how Warrior Pharaoh, Ramses the Great, earned his legendary status. In the shadow of his first giant temple, they unearth a buried building filled with bones. Further south, in search of mummies, they scour a mountain of the dead to find out how the great King's legacy fared as Egypt's golden age began to crumble.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In Norway, recovery teams face mounting pressure as multiple truck accidents, difficult conditions and high-risk rescues test their skills

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: An investigation into an Alpine avalanche in 1999, which resulted in the village of Galtur in the Paznaun valley being buried under 170,000 tonnes of snow, despite the fact the popular ski resort had previously been designated a 'safe zone'

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: With flames emerging through the cockpit floor, the pilots of Pilgrim Airline 458 somehow manage to land safely - but the inferno doesn't stop there

programme.title: World War II: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: Rare footage of the most significant events of the Second World War, including the landings on the island of Saipan and D-Day in Normandy

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: An isolated American battalion makes a desperate stand on Battle Mountain as relentless German attacks threaten to overwhelm their position

programme.title: Erased: WWII Heroes of Colour
programme.desc: This episode explores the untold story of the Black Panthers, an elite African American tank battalion. Unseen diaries and rare interviews chart the unit's action through France, Belgium and Germany, including in the bloodiest American battle of WW2: the Battle of the Bulge. Their experiences inspired not just the fight for civil rights in the U.S. but also battles for freedom worldwide.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The complicated investigation into the crash of TANS Peru Flight 204 on the approach to Pucallpa airport in August 2005. Key evidence was looted from the wreckage

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Simon and Siouxsie have to break up two mating boomslang snakes before they are attacked by a mob throwing stones at them

programme.title: The Incredible Dr Pol

programme.title: Yukon Vet

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans

programme.title: Cruise TV with LoveitBookit

programme.title: The Incredible Dr Pol
programme.desc: Dr Brenda removes an abscess from the head of a puppy, before Dr Pol determines why a horse is struggling to chew, and helps a pregnant cow

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo
programme.desc: The baby animals at the zoo, including goats, a trio of fluffy flamingo chicks, a baby gazelle, and a feisty eland calf

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Simon and Siouxsie receive a distressed phone call, and discover that a nearby fire has led to Cape Town being overrun with cobras fleeing to safety

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Journey to the untamed wilderness of Southern Africa's Bushveld region, home to some of the African continent's most iconic predators

programme.title: The Incredible Dr Pol

programme.title: Heartland Docs

programme.title: Wild Florida
programme.desc: Part two of two. Documentary exploring the state's wildlife and predators, including the harsh odds of survival facing a set of newborn alligator hatchlings

programme.title: When Sharks Attack 360
programme.desc: Investigation into a devastating shark bite in Australia, and a hunt for clues in attacks across the globe before analysing the data in a cutting-edge lab

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Machines with Chris Barrie
programme.desc: The presenter looks back at 100 years of technology and inventions, beginning with the 1910s, the decade that produced new weapons, planes and ships for use in the First World War

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Dr Oakley treats two stubborn muskoxen and a particularly wily coyote. A badly burned dog receives an innovative, if fishy, new treatment

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers - but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Alone and far from home, Kio and his brothers must survive in territories ruled by rival males. Bjoern battles a blizzard to recover the snow plough so the pass can be reopened.

programme.desc: Mmamotse's rule has turned the kingdom upside down. Her legacy now depends on a princess stepping up to the throne. programme.title: The Real Des: The Dennis Nilsen Story
programme.desc: Following on from the three-part drama about the serial killer Dennis Nilsen, this documentary explores the personality of the man behind the crimes - on the surface a mild-mannered civil servant who admitted to murdering up to 15 young men over a four-year period in the late 1980s and early 1980s, disposing of their bodies in the garden and down the drain. The film includes footage of an interview Nilsen gave to ITV at Albany Prison in 1992, contributions from victims' families and insights from criminologist David Wilson, who corresponded with Nilsen over several decades. Narrated by David Tennant

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with a 1936 edition of Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide, Michael Portillo ventures onto the European rail network, beginning an emotional rail journey which takes him deep into his family's past. In the golden city of Salamanca in northwestern Spain, Michael visits the University to hear of opposition to the fascist takeover of Spain by General Francisco Franco, and gains access to the General's archive of enemies of the state. Travelling onto the capital city of Madrid, Michael hears how the bombing of a small town in the Basque region in 1937 inspired one of the 20th century's most shocking works of art, before making his way to the town of Huesca. Michael's final stop is on the border with France at Canfranc station, where he learns of the role the old terminus played in the evacuation of Jews during the Second World War

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels from the chateaux of the Loire Valley to the heart of the Champagne region at Reims, beginning in the city of Orleans in north-central France. Here, he follows his Bradshaw's guide to the magnificent stained-glass windows of the Cathedral of Sainte-Croix, which tell the story of the heroine of France, Joan of Arc. Later, Michael takes a spin around the track at Le Mans in a French-built car, before making his way to the capital city of Paris. East of Paris, Michael finishes this leg of his journey in style with a tour of the cellars at Domaine Pommery in Reims

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures on a rail journey through Germany, guided by Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide published in 1936. Starting in the vibrant city of Berlin, Michael visits the Museum of Modern Art in Berlin's Kreuzberg, where he sees how a leading artist of the era, George Grosz, warned of the rise of fascism in a haunting self-portrait. In the Schöneberg district of the capital, Michael researches the decadent night scene of the 1920s, and looks at how cabaret culture is being revived today. When he reaches Weimar, Michael investigates the beginnings of Bauhaus design and visits the movement's first building, before travelling onto Stuttgart, where he takes a ride in a high-performance Porsche to the manufacturer's Stuttgart headquarters

programme.title: Bangers & Cash

programme.title: Bangers & Cash

programme.title: The Buildings That Fought Hitler

programme.title: Rise of the Nazis: The Manhunt
programme.desc: After the Nuremberg trial, the most senior ranking Nazis had been executed or imprisoned - but many of the worst criminals were still at large. They included Adolf Eichmann, who arranged the transportation of millions of Europe's Jewish people to death camps, and Nazi secret police chief Klaus Barbie, who became known as 'the Butcher of Lyon' because of his reputation for extreme cruelty. This documentary follows the hunt for these two war criminals

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
