programme.desc: Leading a double life is proving tricky for Val. He's spending more time in the human village, and his friendship with Gertie is growing but so are Vernon's suspicions. When Victor admits to losing the castle in a card game to his nemesis Alexis, Val realises he needs to be in two places at once to keep both his friends and family happy

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts another first-round match as sci-fi fans Two Hearts take on science enthusiasts Ad Astra. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues comprising question hard, comically criticise, illegally hunt, and pus-filled swelling

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Quiz hosted by Susan Calman in which one contestant becomes the Boss and has to use judgement and tactics to decide which player is best suited to answer questions

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo boards a barge on the Dudley Canal and travels through the second longest navigable tunnel in the UK, while marvelling at a vast cave known as the Singing Cavern. At nearby Wren's Nest, a former limestone quarry that's now part of Unesco's Black Country Geopark, he discovers an ancient seabed. In the town of Smethwick, Michael speaks to the son of 1960's anti-racist activist

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: Hugh Wallace visits returned asset manager Eoghan O'Riain, who is restoring a former seaside guesthouse in his native Rathmullan, County Donegal, and hoping to transform it into a cosy home for himself and his dog Charlie. The front rooms of the house will be given some updating by Eoghan himself, while the area at the back of the house will make way for a modern kitchen extension

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team return to Dyrham Park in Gloucestershire, where treasured finds include a rare and valuable silver beaker, an 18th-century embroidered court dress, and a brooch the Queen Mother gave to her head chef in 1937

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Philip Serrell and Nick Davies scour the crowd at Tilbury Docks in Essex to find objects to take off to auction, while Paul Martin explores the history of the docks

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Cheryl Baker, Rick Edwards, Toby Olubi and Lou Sanders test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games across the week

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor presents a guide for viewers through all the backstage ballroom action, including a chat with the week's pro panel and an exclusive first look at how some of the celebrities are handling their next dances

programme.title: Gymnastics: World Championships 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the women's team final, held at Rotterdam Ahoy, the Netherlands. This event was last part of the championships three years ago in Antwerp, where a USA team featuring Simone Biles took the honours ahead of Brazil and France in the silver and bronze positions respectively. It was one of four golds that Biles took that year, with the others coming in the Individual all-around, balance beam and floor disciplines

programme.title: Six Wives with Lucy Worsley
programme.desc: The historian explores the fate of the last three wives of Henry VIII. First, Lucy witnesses Henry's doomed courtship with Anne of Cleves, with Henry successfully reneging on their marriage having claimed it had yet to be consummated. Two weeks later, Henry married teenager Catherine Howard, but an act of adultery with a courtier saw the young woman convicted of treason and beheaded. Finally, Lucy explores Henry's relationship with his last wife Katherine Parr, and how she managed to win Henry round despite their greatly differing religious beliefs

programme.title: Ellie & Natasia
programme.desc: Return of the comedy sketch show written by and starring Ellie White and Natasia Demetriou, featuring a guest appearance from Steve Coogan. There is a deeply passionate food review from the mums centred around bread, and internet entrepreneurs Donna and Nikki trying to scale their beauty empire to dizzying new heights

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Paddy O'Connell

programme.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
programme.desc: The BBC's world affairs editor reflects on the week's major global news stories, talking to local experts from around the world to go behind the headlines

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: When a surfer is left paralysed by a wave, the Appledore crew are tasked with an immediate launch. It soon becomes clear that the casualty has been saved from drowning by a teenage boy. In Little and Broad Haven, south Wales, there's a frantic search for two paddleboarders swept over a mile out to sea. Also, the Hayling Island crew race against time to rescue a fisherman trapped in mud

programme.title: Secrets and Spies: A Nuclear Game
programme.desc: In 1985, a very tense time, a young Mikhail Gorbachev is instated as the new leader of the Soviet Union. East and West have been publicly stockpiling nuclear weapons for decades, neither side wanting to appear weak. Plus, the spying game threatens the first tentative moves towards peace

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot reaches Donegal Town, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its flecked fabric. He visits Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house, where he and Bangladeshi-born chef Rana cook railway curry using outstanding local lamb and potatoes. For pudding, Dermot bakes a classic Irish apple pie with chef Brian McDermott, who explain how the rain improves local produce

programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Irish chef and author Clodagh McKenna hosts a big gathering for friends and family in her garden featuring a super-easy menu. Among the dishes she makes for the event are a speedy garden herb dip, a crowd-pleasing chocolate beef chilli and a showstopping tarte Tatin using shop-bought puff pastry

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: The Fletchers start making plans to reclaim more of their farmland, with Kelvin keen to grow oats again, while Liz wants them to try growing maize. All four children get hands-on during lambing, with nine-year-old Marnie bottle feeding a cade lamb after it is rejected by its mother

programme.title: The Voice UK
programme.desc: Emma Willis hosts as the battle rounds begin, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones putting their teams through more challenges Joined by special guest mentors, the coaches prepare their artists for a series of head-to-head performances before making the difficult decision of which three singers from each team will progress to the semi-final

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James cooks two vegan dishes for comedian and TV presenter Sara Pascoe, while the guest chefs are Francesco Mazzei, Richard Bertinet and Alistair Barsby

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Alan is joined by Mark Benton, Elizabeth Carling and Bill Fellows, while florist Simon Lycett creates a new centrepiece for the barn using seasonal blooms

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Liz and Kelvin discover that some farming questions are a lot harder to answer than others when Milo gets inquisitive about artificially inseminating the pigs. The farmhouse clear-out begins in earnest as plans are in for the renovation works, while with the Royal Cheshire Country Show looming, Marnie takes on the challenge of halter-training orphan lamb Hope

programme.title: Cooking with the Stars
programme.desc: Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as Bez of Happy Mondays and TV presenters Scarlett Moffatt and Zara McDermott go head-to-head in a three-way cooking battle. programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Jonathan Pryce and Michelle Yeoh. Intending to reap the profits of increased ratings for his global multimedia empire, Elliot Carver attempts to ignite a conflict between Britain and China by sinking a British frigate and shooting down a Chinese fighter plane. The British Secret Service sends James Bond to verify suspicions that Carver is behind the incident.

programme.title: Undercover: A Year in Reform
programme.desc: A year-long undercover investigation filmed across Britain within Reform UK. But only the toughest can endure the extreme weather, scarce food and limited oxygen on these peaks. Using new technology to showcase never-before-filmed animal behavior, Hostile Planet provides unique access to one of the most extreme environments on the planet.

programme.title: Swamp Men

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Ole Henrik faces his biggest-ever challenge when a 20-ton drill rig hangs above a 15-meter cliff. When the drill rig starts to slide towards the edge, the young boss must make a life-or-death decision. On a notorious bend called The Gallows, a truck and trailer crash into hard-packed snow. Thord is on a mission to rescue it, but first, the police need him to turn detective.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: A mother's love is tested to its limits when Pula has no choice but to leave her young cub alone in the kingdom. The Matahta and Western Prides vie for supremacy as their king finally reveals his devious plan. With the Makulu pack training its latest recruits, Kitso prepares to wage war on the hyenas' reign of terror, while hyena queen Mmamotse faces revolt from within her own clan.

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: The professor explores one of Saqqara's last pyramid complexes to illustrate how Ancient Egypt's 'Pyramid Age' came to an end. A worsening climate combined with political upheaval, famine and economic difficulties to plunge the state into a dark era of civil war, with the land dividing into smaller city-states headed by ambitious small-town leaders. In an obscure tomb in Thebes, she uncovers the stories of warriors who fought in the bloody battle that would eventually lead to Egypt's reunification, and reveals how settlers known as the 'Hyksos' tried to infiltrate the fledgling nation's government to seize the throne

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: Joann explores the peak of ancient Egyptian civilisation by looking at the Colossi of Memnon, two massive stone statues depicting Pharaoh Amenhotep III, and examining the lives of the workers and artisans involved in the building of the Valley of the Kings. programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy starring Bill Murray, Sigourney Weaver and Dan Aykroyd. Three university professors researching parapsychology set up in business for themselves when their grant is withdrawn, and soon realise there's a burgeoning market for "ghost busters" in New York City.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy sequel starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver and Harold Ramis. The Ghostbusters are reunited when their old client Dana Barrett calls for help. Now a single parent with an eight-month-old baby son, she is once again having problems with supernatural phenomena.

A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.desc: Comedy starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. With the children now able to walk and talk, the Ubriacco family acquire a mongrel puppy, Rocks. As the Christmas season approaches the family's usual struggles are complicated by the unexpected gift of Daphne, a pampered poodle.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. The new mayor of an American city decides to change the rules to allow anyone to join the police force. The decision proves to be a recipe for unadulterated chaos.

programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. When cutbacks mean the closure of one of the state's two police academies, both institutions become locked in a desperate battle for survival.

Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

The breathless life of young singles in Chicago is the pattern for Danny and Bernie - fast women, late nights and tall stories fill the noisy, boozy evenings after a hard or not-so-hard day's work. Buddies of a feather, for ever, or so it seems, until Danny falls in love.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: Historical satire starring Steve Buscemi and Simon Russell Beale. In the immediate aftermath of Joseph Stalin's death in 1953, his cabinet jockey for position in the hope of becoming the next Soviet leader. As they argue over everything from funeral arrangements to the fate of the dictator's offspring, the divided government struggles to maintain order.

programme.title: We're the Millers

programme.title: White Chicks
programme.desc: Comedy starring Marlon Wayans and Shawn Wayans. Two black brothers are threatened with expulsion from the FBI following a failed drugs bust. In an attempt to save their jobs, they disguise themselves as rich, white socialite sisters to uncover and foil a kidnapping plot.

programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Smith and Eva Mendes. Alex "Hitch" Hitchens is a professional and deliberately anonymous New York "date doctor" who helps male clients woo the women of their dreams. But his success leads to trouble when tenacious gossip columnist Sara Melas decides to unmask him.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: A retiree grows tired of the quiet life and becomes an intern at a start-up run by a beautiful entrepreneur, and teaches the young staff a few things about successful business. Comedy, starring Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway and Rene Russo

programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson as the accident-prone Mr Bean. In an attempt to get rid of him from his job as one of their attendants, the governors of the National Gallery send Mr Bean to America to represent them at the unveiling of the Grierson Gallery's new purchase. Needless to say disaster is never far away.

In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Mulholland Drive
programme.desc: Psychological thriller directed by David Lynch, starring Naomi Watts, Laura Elena Harring and Justin Theroux. An aspiring actress lands in Hollywood and is quickly drawn into the mystery of an amnesiac woman who has arrived at her lodgings. Meanwhile, a director battles sinister forces to try to complete his latest film.

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: Mulholland Drive
programme.desc: Psychological thriller directed by David Lynch, starring Naomi Watts, Laura Elena Harring and Justin Theroux. An aspiring actress lands in Hollywood and is quickly drawn into the mystery of an amnesiac woman who has arrived at her lodgings. Meanwhile, a director battles sinister forces to try to complete his latest film.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: Cool Hand Luke
programme.desc: Prison drama starring Paul Newman and George Kennedy. After being sentenced to two years on a chain gang, Luke Jackson is faced with the unrelenting demands of the camp's daily routine. However, his resilience quickly antagonises the gang boss.

programme.title: Boyz N the Hood
programme.desc: Urban drama starring Larry Fishburne, Ice Cube and Cuba Gooding Jr. South Central Los Angeles, 1984: young Tre's mother decides it would be in his best interest to live with his estranged but disciplined dad. Seven years on, he has managed to steer clear of the drugs and the violence but, as the teenage gang wars begin to invade his neighbourhood, it becomes almost impossible for him and his friends to avoid trouble.

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

programme.desc: New York bachelor David is due to drive to his friend's wedding, but a wheel clamp on his vehicle derails those plans. He acquires a new drive from the mysterious Car Rental Company managed by two nameless agents, who are oddly familiar with his dating history. At the wedding, David meets fellow singleton Sarah and squanders an opportunity to dance with her. On the way home, the rental car's GPS asks him if he would like to embark on a big bold beautiful journey. When David agrees, the virtual assistant guides him to Sarah and they follow a winding route between physical doors that open into episodes from their respective pasts. Romantic drama, starring Colin Farrell and Margot Robbie

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: Comedy drama, based on the true story of conman Frank Abagnale Jr, starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks. Shattered by the news that his parents are divorcing, 16-year-old Frank runs away to New York. For six years he lives a life of fraud, cashing over $2 million in bad cheques while impersonating an airline pilot, a paediatrician and a lawyer, and always staying one step ahead of tenacious FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

programme.title: Ferrari
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Adam Driver and Penélope Cruz. Enzo Ferrari and his wife Laura have equal shares in their car-manufacturing company, but their marriage is in tatters following the death of their son, while the business is in financial peril. With the 1957 Mille Miglia endurance race looming, Enzo seeks victory for Ferrari, whatever the cost.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Boyz N the Hood
programme.desc: Urban drama starring Larry Fishburne, Ice Cube and Cuba Gooding Jr. South Central Los Angeles, 1984: young Tre's mother decides it would be in his best interest to live with his estranged but disciplined dad. Seven years on, he has managed to steer clear of the drugs and the violence but, as the teenage gang wars begin to invade his neighbourhood, it becomes almost impossible for him and his friends to avoid trouble.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Tessa Thompson and Chris Hemsworth. Agent M, an eager rookie in the secret MIB organiation, is sent to the London office where she's partnered with laid-back Agent H. When their first assignment together ends in disaster, M begins to suspect a mole must have infiltrated the agency. But who could it be - and is her partner to be trusted?

programme.title: Constantine
programme.desc: Supernatural action fantasy based on the Hellblazer comic book, starring Keanu Reeves as troubled Los Angeles exorcist John Constantine. After a young Catholic girl takes her own life, Constantine is approached by her grieving twin sister. As they begin to investigate, they enter a world of the supernatural that sees the pair come face to face with the hidden evil that inhabits the Earth.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Men In Black Films
programme.desc: A look at the blockbusting fantasy comedies, starring Will Smith, Tommy Lee Jones and more

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sci-fi action sequel starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. The ancient history of the Transformers' presence on Earth is revealed as the human race battles the first ever Decepticon, and once again Sam Witwicky is in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Shia LaBeouf. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must spring back into action when a Decepticon, secretly planted on the Moon in the 1960s, becomes a clear and present danger. Not only is the technology contained within it potentially devastating to humankind, but Sam is also dealing with relationship problems.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Chris Pine and Zachary Quinto. Rebellious youth James Kirk is persuaded to join the Starfleet Academy, where he befriends Dr Leonard "Bones" McCoy and clashes with officer Spock. When an evil Romulan arrives from the future, the young crew of the USS Enterprise find themselves in the thick of the action.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: Midnight Run
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Robert De Niro and Charles Grodin. Bounty hunter Jack Walsh is just the man to bring embezzler Jonathan "The Duke" Mardukas to justice. Down on his luck, the $100,000 fee is just what Jack needs right now. The only problem is that Mardukas cheated the Mafia out of a cool $15 million, and they want their money back. Can Jack beat the FBI and an unscrupulous rival to his quarry?

programme.title: Censor
programme.desc: After viewing a strangely familiar video, Enid, a film censor, sets out to solve the mystery of her sister's disappearance. Horror thriller, starring Niamh Algar, Michael Smiley and Nicholas Burns

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Francis and Donna Reed. The new medical officer at a remote fort comes in for criticism when he provides treatment to the local native American tribe.

programme.title: Sign of the Pagan
programme.desc: Enthusiastic historical drama set in 450AD. Jack Palance stars as Attila the Hun, who vows to conquer the mighty Roman Empire. programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama based on the novel by Andy Weir, starring Matt Damon. After a manned mission to Mars is hit by a ferocious storm, Mark Watney is left behind when his fellow crew members make their escape. Using scientific knowledge, ingenuity and drawing on seemingly inexhaustible levels of resolve, Mark must find a way to survive long enough to be rescued.

programme.title: The World's End

In 1998, with the apocalypse apparently averted following the events of Terminator 2: Judgment Day, humanity's saviour John Connor is targeted for assassination by a time-travelling T-800 cyborg. John's mother, Sarah, is once again thrust into the battle for Earth's future as a new artificial intelligence gains sentience.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: A multi-millionaire speedboat racing champion leads a double life that lands him in trouble with the police and drug lords. Action adventure, starring John Travolta, Katheryn Winnick, Jennifer Esposito and Matthew Modine

programme.title: Sniper: Special Ops
programme.desc: An elite military force is sent on a rescue mission which proves successful, but one of the soldiers is left behind when he goes to help a wounded man. The leader of the squad is forbidden from going back for him, but disobeys orders to lead his men on a desperate rescue mission. Action thriller, starring Steven Seagal and Tim Abell

programme.title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
programme.desc: Part one of two. Brady heads for the bright lights of San Francisco, to take part in a big card game. Western drama, starring Kenny Rogers and Reba McEntire

In an attempt to avoid being trapped in their crosshairs, the adventurers try to cross a bridge spanning a deep gorge, but a bomb sends Summerlee into the depths below. Marguerite and Veronica mount a search to track down and save their friend. Tribune has rescued Roxton from death, but he demands a favor in kind.

programme.title: Retreat
programme.desc: Psychological thriller starring Cillian Murphy, Thandie Newton and Jamie Bell.A couple working through their relationship problems on a secluded island stumble upon a wounded soldier who tells them the mainland has been devastated by a windborne virus.

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors
programme.desc: Conspiracies run wild at breakfast and one mistake in the mission could cause heads to roll. Suspicions rise at the round table leaving the traitors deflecting accusations

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
programme.desc: Ed Gamble hears from the latest banished and murdered players from episode 6 about their time in the castle. He gets their reactions to the Traitors' identities and finds out how they feel about the biggest betrayals, twists and suspicions

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Denise Nurse helps Susi, Sam and Rupert the dog leave busy Bedfordshire behind for south Devon, with £500,000 to find an annexe, more space and perhaps even a sea view

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Five more sellers enter the room. There's a battle for sporting goods, two giant posters need a new home, and a retro piece prompts a charity auction like no other

programme.title: The Reluctant Vampire
programme.desc: Leading a double life is proving tricky for Val. He's spending more time in the human village, and his friendship with Gertie is growing but so are Vernon's suspicions. When Victor admits to losing the castle in a card game to his nemesis Alexis, Val realises he needs to be in two places at once to keep both his friends and family happy

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts another first-round match as sci-fi fans Two Hearts take on science enthusiasts Ad Astra. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues comprising question hard, comically criticise, illegally hunt, and pus-filled swelling

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Quiz hosted by Susan Calman in which one contestant becomes the Boss and has to use judgement and tactics to decide which player is best suited to answer questions

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo boards a barge on the Dudley Canal and travels through the second longest navigable tunnel in the UK, while marvelling at a vast cave known as the Singing Cavern. At nearby Wren's Nest, a former limestone quarry that's now part of Unesco's Black Country Geopark, he discovers an ancient seabed. In the town of Smethwick, Michael speaks to the son of 1960's anti-racist activist

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: Hugh Wallace visits returned asset manager Eoghan O'Riain, who is restoring a former seaside guesthouse in his native Rathmullan, County Donegal, and hoping to transform it into a cosy home for himself and his dog Charlie. The front rooms of the house will be given some updating by Eoghan himself, while the area at the back of the house will make way for a modern kitchen extension

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team return to Dyrham Park in Gloucestershire, where treasured finds include a rare and valuable silver beaker, an 18th-century embroidered court dress, and a brooch the Queen Mother gave to her head chef in 1937

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Philip Serrell and Nick Davies scour the crowd at Tilbury Docks in Essex to find objects to take off to auction, while Paul Martin explores the history of the docks

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Cheryl Baker, Rick Edwards, Toby Olubi and Lou Sanders test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games across the week

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor presents a guide for viewers through all the backstage ballroom action, including a chat with the week's pro panel and an exclusive first look at how some of the celebrities are handling their next dances

programme.title: Gymnastics: World Championships 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the women's team final, held at Rotterdam Ahoy, the Netherlands. This event was last part of the championships three years ago in Antwerp, where a USA team featuring Simone Biles took the honours ahead of Brazil and France in the silver and bronze positions respectively. It was one of four golds that Biles took that year, with the others coming in the Individual all-around, balance beam and floor disciplines

programme.title: Six Wives with Lucy Worsley
programme.desc: The historian explores the fate of the last three wives of Henry VIII. First, Lucy witnesses Henry's doomed courtship with Anne of Cleves, with Henry successfully reneging on their marriage having claimed it had yet to be consummated. Two weeks later, Henry married teenager Catherine Howard, but an act of adultery with a courtier saw the young woman convicted of treason and beheaded. Finally, Lucy explores Henry's relationship with his last wife Katherine Parr, and how she managed to win Henry round despite their greatly differing religious beliefs

programme.title: Ellie & Natasia
programme.desc: Return of the comedy sketch show written by and starring Ellie White and Natasia Demetriou, featuring a guest appearance from Steve Coogan. There is a deeply passionate food review from the mums centred around bread, and internet entrepreneurs Donna and Nikki trying to scale their beauty empire to dizzying new heights

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Paddy O'Connell

programme.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
programme.desc: The BBC's world affairs editor reflects on the week's major global news stories, talking to local experts from around the world to go behind the headlines

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: When a surfer is left paralysed by a wave, the Appledore crew are tasked with an immediate launch. It soon becomes clear that the casualty has been saved from drowning by a teenage boy. In Little and Broad Haven, south Wales, there's a frantic search for two paddleboarders swept over a mile out to sea. Also, the Hayling Island crew race against time to rescue a fisherman trapped in mud

programme.title: Secrets and Spies: A Nuclear Game
programme.desc: In 1985, a very tense time, a young Mikhail Gorbachev is instated as the new leader of the Soviet Union. East and West have been publicly stockpiling nuclear weapons for decades, neither side wanting to appear weak. Plus, the spying game threatens the first tentative moves towards peace

programme.desc: After a neighbor's home burns down, the whole family rallies and organizes a community drive to help do some good - though it's not all good, as Jay throws out his back, Cameron does some posturing with a huge moving truck, Claire discovers that Mitchell and Gloria have been spending a lot of time together, and Luke and Manny get their hands on some of the donated toys.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart and Lisa get to know a homeless folk singer named Hettie, after Bart accidentally loses the shopping trolley containing her possessions and invites her to stay in his bedroom wardrobe. Meanwhile, Homer's attempt at DIY traps the cat in the walls of the house, so he launches a rescue bid

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart and Lisa get to know a homeless folk singer named Hettie, after Bart accidentally loses the shopping trolley containing her possessions and invites her to stay in his bedroom wardrobe. Meanwhile, Homer's attempt at DIY traps the cat in the walls of the house, so he launches a rescue bid

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa is inspired to become a veterinarian and begins an internship at the local vet's surgery, but she learns a tough lesson when the school's neglected hamster dies. Marge gets a job as a crime-scene cleaner, but is traumatised by the gory sights. Michael York guest stars

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge is distressed when Lisa signs up for the opportunity to participate in the future colonisation of Mars, but a cunning strategy using reverse psychology to discourage her daughter from carrying out her plan goes badly awry

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: After getting telephone answering machines, Murray and Pop-Pop wage a message war on one another, so Erica, Barry and Pops try to reunite them at a hockey game

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam tries to be a horror writer, but his efforts get him grounded on Halloween when Beverly discovers that she is the basis for the monster in his story. Erica forces Barry to attend a costume dance with her

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil and Claire drop Haley off at college, and in true Dunphy style, they manage to embarrass her as they do so. Jay and Gloria cause disruption at a baby class, while Cam and Mitchell clash with a lesbian couple when Lily fights with their son at nursery. Comedy, starring Ed O'Neill and Julie Bowen

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil struggles to accept the news when Luke announces he no longer wants to be a magician, and Jay is having trouble getting to sleep thanks to Gloria's loud snoring. Mitch and Cam swap duties, with Mitch staying at home with Lily, and Cam setting off for his first day as the new music teacher at Luke and Manny's school

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The friends pitch in for a yard sale to help raise money for the school but problems arise when Manny comes across an old trunk containing a secret of Gloria's. Phil finds himself in a bit of a pickle, feeling pressured to sell and buy something, while Alex's new boyfriend is subjected to Claire's thorough interrogation. Will she approve of him or will it turn out that she preferred Dylan?

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay can't believe his luck when he gets out of a shopping trip - until he receives a visit from ex-wife Dede, the last person he was expecting to see on his doorstep. Knowing how much trouble she can cause, he is keen to get rid of her as soon as possible - especially as she is yet to find out about Gloria's pregnancy. Meanwhile, Phil and Claire need Mitch's legal help when Haley is arrested for under-age drinking. American comedy, starring Ed O'Neill, with a guest appearance from Shelley Long

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer wins $1million on the lottery, but keeps it a secret from his family, fearing Marge's reaction if she finds out about it. He and Bart set about spending the money, and buy front-row tickets to a Coldplay concert. With the guest voice of Chris Martin

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A romantic evening at the ice-rink leads to Homer and Marge heading for the Winter Olympics to play for a curling team, while Lisa becomes hopelessly addicted to collecting sporting memorabilia and Bart befriends Canada's equivalent of Milhouse

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: When Miss Hoover asks her students to research their family history, Lisa is distressed to discover that most of her forebears seem to have been crooks and deadbeats. Then she finds an old diary in the attic that was written by her ancestor, Eliza Simpson, and describes a remarkable 19th-century adventure

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Mrs Krabappel writes to Bart's parents about his bad behaviour when he fails to hand in his homework. After a conference with Principal Skinner, Homer insists on punishing his son, but Marge is more sympathetic, inspiring a scheming Bart to start pitting them against each other

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Jenson's past is quickly catching up to him, and Theresa finds herself in the middle of a dangerous mess. Elsewhere, Abigail continues to abuse her position of power

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: When Peralta notices Holt is in a bad mood, he teams up with the captain's husband Kevin to find out what has gone wrong. Boyle tries to get a confession out of an elderly bank-robbery suspect (played by Happy Days creator Garry Marshall), who pretends to be frail and adorable whenever Santiago and Diaz are around

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: A 71-year-old beekeeper is looking for a man with a naughty side to his nature, and a 21-year-old is reluctant to venture from his house, which has dented his chances of romance. Other visitors to the restaurant include a charity shop manager who has his wedding all mapped out and a Welsh hairdresser who, after a string of failed relationships, spends the evening meeting a part-time model

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In the first half of a two-part rescue mission at Lyla's Family Restaurant, in the Ohio suburb of Cuyahoga Falls, owner Waleed's American dream has turned into a full-blown Nightmare. The dining room is dated, the overwhelming menu has more than 200 items, and the team are at breaking point, with frequent shouting matches between the staff. But owner Waleed is still firmly in denial. Gordon faces one of his biggest challenges yet to try and rescue this restaurant

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The sofa-critics watch The Crown, I'm a Celebrity… Get Me Out Of Here!, You Won't Believe This, Down to Earth with Zac Efron, This Morning with Marie Kondo, The Hidden Lives of Pets, and ITV News and the World Cup

programme.title: Dating Naked USA
programme.desc: Diane is a vivacious blonde looking for the man of her dreams, and Keegan is a muscular jock looking for the right girl

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Sean Lock is joined by Andrew Flintoff to battle guest captain Bill Bailey and team-mate Roisin Conaty as Jimmy Carr hosts another edition of the game show mash-up. Susie Dent is ably assisted by Rob Beckett in the Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley deals with the numbers and letters

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Greg Davies welcomes five new contestants as David Baddiel, Ed Gamble, Jo Brand, Katy Wix and Rose Matafeo begin another chaotic series of bizarre tasks. Eggplants, popsicles and dramatic entrances all become unexpectedly important as the comedians desperately try to impress the Taskmaster. Meanwhile, Alex Horne carefully observes every triumph and disaster from the sidelines.

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: YouTube star and internet sensation Bethany Mota goes undercover to meet up-and-coming social media hopefuls who are trying to break through. Disguised as an ordinary girl with a punk rock style who dreams of starting her own channel, Bethany meets a world champion beat-boxer, a pair of comical twin pranksters and an inspiring hip hop dance teacher. In the end, Bethany reveals her true identity in a surprising way and helps make their dreams come true

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: American football and baseball star Deion Sanders goes undercover to meet inspiring sports coaches and deserving fans. Disguised as a businessman who hopes to start a youth football programme, Deion meets two coaches who work with inner-city kids and a remarkable fan with a really surprising story. In the end, Deion reveals his true identity to reward their generosity and help turn their dreams into reality

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Roxi and Glen are the first couple to play host in Southampton, where things get off to a bad start as all the others are dreading their cauliflower puree starter. On the second evening, Russell and Lisa's pork dish and salmon main get raised eyebrows from their guests, although the food is not the only problem as animosity is brewing between two of the women. Tennis fans John and Suzy bring the week to a close - can they serve up an ace menu and walk away with the prize?

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In east Lancashire, newly engaged Andrew and Sue offer a menu of classic tried and tested dishes. Joining them are laid back Ben and Ruth, and drama lovers Helen and Victoria. Day two sees Ben and prankster Ruth host. Although their breakfast theme intrigues their guests, will it be dinner party standard? Finally, it's the turn of drama teacher Helen, and saleswoman by day, singer by night, Victoria, to show the competition how it's really done

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Essex groom Gary plans an aquatic wedding 200 miles from home. But Lauren hopes for a home counties service. Will Gary's underwater dream sink without a trace?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: While Sofia dreams of a boho beach blessing, Craig is planning an Oktoberfest wedding featuring short leather trousers. Will Sofia call time on their nuptials?

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Dotsons return. Dave tries to get his motors runnin', Darrell stumbles over a curious collection and Rene finally goes nuts.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Costa Mesa offers Rene a bit of unexpected "high" tech; while Darrell goes on a cross-cultural haberdashery journey.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Dippin' Dots is an American brand that sells cryogenically frozen beads of ice-cream. Recently, it enjoyed its busiest summer, scooping 146 billion dots and making an annual revenue of $300million. But, before that, in 2012, the company was on the brink of bankruptcy, until owner and CEO Scott Fischer turned its fortunes around. Here, he infiltrates his workforce to find out if his expanding empire has the manpower to cope. As his alter ego Brad, a man looking for a new career, he goes undercover, meeting a factory production operator, a warehouse supervisor, a sales supervisor and a server

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Stacy Anderson, the brand president of global business Anytime Fitness, poses as a potential franchise owner to make sure all companies using the name are offering the same experience. She meets a gym manager, a personal trainer and a franchise owner to see if they company is fighting fit

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Alfonso Ribeiro presents light-hearted entertainment and family-friendly laughs, as viewers' home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Indio, California proves to be extremely interesting for Dave. Brandi and Jarrod find the ultimate stash, while Mary's locker misfires.

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Below Deck

programme.title: Midnight Run
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Robert De Niro and Charles Grodin. Bounty hunter Jack Walsh is just the man to bring embezzler Jonathan "The Duke" Mardukas to justice. Down on his luck, the $100,000 fee is just what Jack needs right now. The only problem is that Mardukas cheated the Mafia out of a cool $15 million, and they want their money back. Can Jack beat the FBI and an unscrupulous rival to his quarry?

programme.title: Censor
programme.desc: After viewing a strangely familiar video, Enid, a film censor, sets out to solve the mystery of her sister's disappearance. Horror thriller, starring Niamh Algar, Michael Smiley and Nicholas Burns

programme.desc: Western starring Robert Francis and Donna Reed. The new medical officer at a remote fort comes in for criticism when he provides treatment to the local native American tribe.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures on a rail journey through Germany, guided by Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide published in 1936. Starting in the vibrant city of Berlin, Michael visits the Museum of Modern Art in Berlin's Kreuzberg, where he sees how a leading artist of the era, George Grosz, warned of the rise of fascism in a haunting self-portrait. In the Schöneberg district of the capital, Michael researches the decadent night scene of the 1920s, and looks at how cabaret culture is being revived today. When he reaches Weimar, Michael investigates the beginnings of Bauhaus design and visits the movement's first building, before travelling onto Stuttgart, where he takes a ride in a high-performance Porsche to the manufacturer's Stuttgart headquarters

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: On a railway journey from the capital Palermo, through the ancient town of Agrigento and the port of Siracusa, to Europe's largest volcano, Mount Etna, Michael Portillo explores Sicilian life under the dictatorship. He also finds out how the dictator took on the Mafia and asks whether it is true that under Mussolini, the trains ran on time

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels by train through Austria and the Czech Republic, beginning in the northern Austrian city of Linz, where Adolf Hitler lived as a young boy. From here, Michael travels onto Prague Central Station, where he meets 87-year-old Zuzana Maresova, who, as a seven-year-old girl climbed aboard a train to travel to safety in London with hundreds of other Jewish children. Eventually crossing the Czech border into Slovakia, Michael reaches his final destination, one of Europe's youngest capital cities, Bratislava

programme.title: Bangers & Cash

programme.desc: The continuing story of the diehards committed to hunt down thousands of Nazi war criminals, some of whom were living in plain sight. programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Provence, starting in the port city of Marseilles. Eva then heads out into the sun-kissed landscape to try the traditional summer vegetable dish of ratatouille and a sun-drenched salad niçoise on the Riviera at the famous Hotel du Cap

programme.title: Time
programme.desc: The possibility of romance and an opportunity at work make Bailey question his choices, and he turns to Marie-Louise in a moment of need. programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow

First shown in 2007

Plus, Paul meets the people trying to safeguard the future of the Suffolk Punch horse, which holds a unique place in the history of the county

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First into the workshop is Margaret Brier from Yorkshire. She's hoping electronics wizard Mark Stuckey can bring an old homemade gramophone back to life. Now little more than a box of bits, the gramophone was built by Margaret's grandfather Harry Bates in the late 1800s. Harry was ahead of his time, a natural-born engineer with a talent for fixing anything, known in Yorkshire as a 'knackler'. Mark calls in help from the Repair Shop's very own 'jack of all trades', Dom Chinea, to remake the missing papier-mâché horn. Meanwhile, Mark works on reviving the flagging gramophone motor. Together the duo restore the voice of this silent gramophone and get it playing once more.
The next visitor to the barn is 19-year-old Charlotte Hughes, also from Yorkshire. She's hoping ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay can help her atone for an accident that left her mother's piggy bank smashed and shattered into pieces. A well-intentioned attempt to mend it has left unsightly cracks and a gaping hole in piggy's cheek. Along the way he's also lost his cork and trotters. Charlotte is desperate to make it up to her mum, Liz, who was understandably upset when she discovered this important memento from childhood was broken. Ceramics restorer Kirsten Ramsey has her work cut out to undo the old repairs and stabilise the cracks. Working her magic to perfect the piggy bank in time for Liz and Charlotte to return to collect it.
Finally, Jay Blades and Brenton West welcome Teresa Oates, and her partner, Ron, to the barn. Theresa wants silversmith Brenton to restore an antique to help someone very dear to her. The couple have brought in a Prussian helmet, the 19th-century German ceremonial helmet is a family heirloom. Teresa's dad, Edward, was a D-Day veteran and soldier during the Allied occupation. He brought the tarnished memento home when he returned from service and Teresa and Ron are hoping that by restoring the helmet they may help Edward (who is suffering from dementia) refresh his memory. Leather expert Suzie Fletcher steps in to create a new skull and chin strap, while Brenton works to revitalize the rusting and tarnished helmet, achieving a stunning transformation.

programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First at the barn is Andy Crook from Cornwall. His hopes for restoring a very special inheritance rests on musical instrument expert Pete Woods. The rather tarnished tuba belonged to his late father, Frank. Both he and Andy played in various brass bands over the years and shared a real love for performing. Andy discovered the tuba in his mother's loft after decades of believing it was long gone. He dreams of being able to play his beloved dad's instrument. However, the tuba has been rendered mute from damage caused over 30 years ago - a crucial valve is missing, and a leaking joint makes this fix a tricky one for Pete.
Horologist Steve Fletcher's skills are really put the test when Kamal from Cheshire arrives with her family's mantel clock. Her Sikh parents came from India just after the second world war and, although it was a struggle for them to settle in Yorkshire, they made a happy life and Kamal is hugely proud of them. The clock was the beating heart of their household. She clearly remembers the sweet chime and she yearns to hear it once again. After years of being stored in the basement of her childhood home and only recently unearthed, the metal encased clock is in a bad way, but Steve rolls up his sleeves and brings it back to life.
And silversmith Brenton West is intrigued by an Asian curiosity brought in by Tracy Lavery and her daughter Zoe. The bronze pot is in the form of a lion dog with a hinged head and is thought to have been designed for burning incense. It joined Tracey's family when her grandfather brought it back from his worldly travels and has been passed from mother to daughter ever since. It's been used as a money pot mainly and has captivated each family member. However, at the ripe old age of at least one hundred, he is desperate for an over haul - his tail has detached, his hinge is broken and he's cracked in places but fortunately he's in safe hands with Brenton.

programme.desc: As 'Dirt Dogs' Vern and Leon are forced to uproot their operation, 'Gold Gypsies' Chris and Greg face a huge decision, and remote prospectors Henri and Kelli strike salt-lake gold.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr Pol

programme.title: Yukon Vet

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans

programme.title: The Incredible Dr Pol

programme.title: Snakes in the City

programme.title: The Incredible Dr Pol

programme.title: Heartland Docs

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean
programme.desc: The wild Pacific covers one third of our planet. It has the most volcanoes, the biggest earthquakes, deepest trenches, and the most islands on Earth. Found in icy sub-Antarctic waters, tropical coral seas, and still smoking volcanic arcs, there is no such thing as a typical Pacific island. The wildest and most bizarre creatures have evolved to thrive on these unique Islands of Life, often surviving nowhere else on Earth.

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean
programme.desc: The ocean is full of wonders, but creating them has been a bloody battle for over half a billion years, as evermore complex animals fight for survival. They evolved new ways to hunt, overpower and kill and eat each other. And astonishing adaptations to defend themselves, hide and escape detection. Passing those amazing new abilities on to the next generation can be a bruising battle in itself as males fight each other for the right to mate.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack 360
programme.desc: The team investigates a flurry of shark bites off the coast of Long Island, as Diva calls upon local experts and takes a dive in search of answers

programme.title: Megafactories

programme.title: Yukon Vet

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will struggles in bone-chilling winds in the South Pole, where temperatures can drop below -100°F. He skis, treks and climbs across giant icefields and cliffs with the support of one of the world's best polar athletes, Richard Parks. In one of the planet's most isolated research stations, scientists take ice cores deep under the surface and make incredible sacrifices to pursue their research.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, a man scared of spiders his whole life, ventures deep into the Ecuadorian Amazon in search of deadly creatures. Joined by professor Bryan Fry and local mountaineer Carla Perez, they abseil 200 feet into a cave network known as the "womb of the Earth," to discover the giant tarantula. Using cutting-edge techniques, they extract its venom, which could hold the key to saving millions of lives.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, Bryan and Carla join local Waorani elder Penti Baihua in the Amazon, in search of the world's biggest snake: the giant green anaconda. They carefully remove just one scale from the 17-foot snake's skin. Will's fear turns into relief, then joy. The single scale can reveal the health of the entire ecosystem - crucial for the future of both wildlife and the Waorani.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: When blizzards bring chaos to Norway's roads, Thord and his A-Team battle to save a jack-knifed truck. Bjoern is in trouble when a driver with no snow-skills causes gridlock - and can't pay up. In the far north, Jo Roger returns from injury to face a fifty-seven ton mega-truck that threatens to tip over.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: After the death of her mother, Motshidi is starving and alone. In a terrifying reunion with her father, she has everything to lose. But in an uncharacteristic act of charity, Blue Eyes takes pity, giving Motshodi a new lease of life. A violent traitor rises in the rotten ranks, challenging the selfish princess and bringing an end to Mmamotse's rule. The Makulu Pack make one last stand as the battle for supremacy begins, but with the hyenas gone, it's up to Sega to lead the Matahta Pride to victory.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack and Why
programme.desc: Beginning in 2010, a single beach in Bali was the site of seven shark attacks - the first ever recorded along the islands coast

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: Joann explores the peak of ancient Egyptian civilisation by looking at the Colossi of Memnon, two massive stone statues depicting Pharaoh Amenhotep III, and examining the lives of the workers and artisans involved in the building of the Valley of the Kings. This golden age was threatened by the growing power of Karnak's priests, and Joann reveals how Tutankhamen's early death was a chance for Egypt to start afresh and rewrite history, but was undermined by decades of state-sanctioned looting of the tombs

But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Demi Lovato and Rainn Wilson. Smurfette and friends embark on their biggest ever adventure - travelling beyond the Forbidden Forest in search of other Smurfs.

programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jack Black, Dustin Hoffman and Angelina Jolie. Ancient China: Po the Panda lives in the Valley of Peace and dreams of becoming a kung fu master despite the fact he is clumsy, overweight and a complete beginner at martial arts. So when he's accidentally chosen to be the legendary Dragon Warrior, he is overjoyed. However, his joy is short-lived as the evil snow leopard Tai Lung has escaped from captivity and is on his way to the Valley to take his revenge on Po's mentor.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2

programme.desc: Animated comedy adventurel featuring the voices of Jack Black, Angelina Jolie and Dustin Hoffman. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

Young Eliza Thornberry has a very special gift - she can converse with animals. But when a trip with her nature documentary-making family to Africa brings her into contact with evil poachers, the youngster has to decide whether she is prepared to give up this wonderful power to save the country's endangered wildlife.
